title: Umuburo muto imbere y'umuntu urimo kwimuka
intro: Jya mu kibaya aho umutegetsi ukomeye n'ingabo nyinshi begereye, maze utekereze ku mugenzi muto utanga umuburo ukiza umuryango wose. Uko umuryango uri mu kaga ugera aho uhungira, akaga karahanyura. Kurikiza ibimenyetso kugira ngo umenye umuntu wirengagijwe inyuma y'uwo muburo.
clues: Ndi mu biremwa bito bifitanye isano n'ubwami bw'umutegetsi.
Umuryango wanjye uba mu mazu ari mu kibaya, aho umwe muri twe ashobora guhamagara abandi.
Duhanganye n'iterabwoba riturutse kuri uwo mutegetsi n'ingabo zigendana n'uwo mutegetsi.
Ni njye uhamagara umuryango wanjye ngo winjire mu ngo zabo kandi akatuburira ko tutagomba gukandamizwa tutabizi.
Umutegetsi ni Sulayman, kandi ubwoko bwanjye buri mu biremwa byashyizwe munsi y'ubuyobozi bwe.
Ndi ikirura cyo muri icyo kibaya; nyuma yo kuburirwa, twinjiye mu ngo zacu maze duhunga ihungabana ryari kutugeraho ritabaye.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
